parameters.query: select coalesce(json_agg(mail_id), '[]') as known from p3_emails where mail_id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))
select body from kb where id = 1

with e as (
  insert into p3_emails (mail_id, from_addr, subject, received_at, category, summary, urgency)
  values ($1, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz, $5, $6, $7)
  on conflict (mail_id) do nothing
  returning mail_id
), i as (
  insert into p3_invoices (mail_id, vendor, invoice_no, amount, currency, due_date)
  select mail_id, $8, $9, nullif($10, '')::numeric, $11, nullif($12, '')::date from e where $8 <> ''
  on conflict (vendor, invoice_no) do nothing
  returning 1
), d as (
  insert into p3_drafts (mail_id, to_addr, subject, body)
  select mail_id, $2, 'Re: ' || $3, $13 from e where $13 <> ''
  returning 1
)
select (select count(*) from e)::int as saved, $5 as category, $7 as urgency, ($8 <> '') as invoice, ($13 <> '') as draft
